changeSet.author: modarelli
changeSet.sql: create table app_user ( id bigint generated always as identity primary key, public_id uuid not null unique, login varchar(50) not null, password_hash varchar(255) not null, first_name varchar(50), last_name varchar(50), email varchar(254) not null, image_url varchar(256), lang_key varchar(10) not null, activated boolean not null default true, created_at timestamp with time zone not null, constraint uk_app_user_login unique(login), constraint uk_app_user_email unique(email), constraint ck_app_user_login_lower check (login = lower(login)), constraint ck_app_user_email_lower check (email = lower(email)) );
